title: NOVA AI inside my MMO reads the player chat and ships updates live — 80%+ of VANTA//7 is now player-generated
author: Particular-Let9884
selftext:
VANTA//7 is a first-person cyberpunk MMO that runs in the browser. 100+ players have been active so far, some with 30+ hours in it. And more than 80% of its content was generated by the players themselves.



\*\*NOVA: the AI that runs the game\*\*



Inside the game lives NOVA, an AI that reads the player chat. She has a huge amount of data to audit everything that's been said, decides what's worth doing, and ships the changes straight to the live game:

• new content

• bug fixes

• more new content



Players ask in the chat, NOVA builds it. That's how 80%+ of the game ended up being player-generated.



\*\*How it works\*\*



1. A player asks for something in the chat.

2. The request is queued for Claude Opus 5.5.

3. The database checks it against a strict set of restrictions.

4. If it passes, the work starts, and the result goes live in the game.



\*\*The setup\*\*



• Code: Claude Opus. Three.js for the engine.

• Visuals: Higgsfield for 3D models (weapons, robots), textures and holographic item sprites.

• Music: Higgsfield, one track per mood.

• Voices: ElevenLabs and Higgsfield. Full EN/FR.

• In-game AI characters powered by Claude, including Pomi, a holographic guide who remembers each player across conversations.



\*\*Iteration beats prompting\*\*



The first version was a rainy street in Kōwa-Bas. Nothing else. Then came one layer at a time: missions, classes, a life sim, multiple districts, flying cars, day/night and weather, multiplayer. No single prompt could have produced this.

\*\*Try it\*\*
